parsed_response.reasoning: The new group_member.hbs renders `{{#unless automatic}}...remove...{{/unless}}` within an {{each member in members itemView="group-member"}} whose template context is the member (a Discourse.User). Unlike group.hbs, which sits in the controller's ObjectController context where `automatic` proxies to the group model, this template's `automatic` resolves against the user record, where it is undefined, so the unless-block renders the remove link even for automatic groups. The server (remove_member) then rejects the resulting DELETE with 422 can_not_modify_automatic, so the UI offers an action that always fails — a regression versus the old UI which disabled member editing for automatic groups. The exact Ember fallback behavior for unresolved properties onto the parent controller is not fully provable from the diff alone, but the context mismatch is real and the mechanism is plausible.

judged_text: The per-member template gates the remove link on {{#unless automatic}}, but inside the group-member view the context is the member (a Discourse.User), so 'automatic' resolves against the user record, is undefined, and the link renders for automatic groups too. Admins viewing an automatic group (e.g. admins/moderators) see a working remove icon on each member; clicking it triggers DELETE /admin/groups/:id/members which the server rejects with 422 can_not_modify_automatic, surfacing an error after the fact instead of never offering the action — the old UI correctly disabled member editing for automatic groups.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs` the remove link is gated by `{{#unless automatic}}`, but this template is rendered as an item view via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`. In that situation the template scope is per-item (the `member`/user), and `automatic` is not provided on `Discourse.User`, so it will resolve as undefined/falsey and the `unless` block will render the remove link even for automatic groups. Clicking it calls the `removeMember` action which issues a DELETE to `/admin/groups/:id/members.json`, and the server-side `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` explicitly rejects automatic groups with `can_not_modify_automatic` (422), meaning the UI offers an action that cannot succeed for automatic groups.
